payload.summary: `bun run dev` starts the whole stack locally
steps: docker compose starts Postgres and Redis and waits for them to be healthy
concurrently runs dev:server, dev:worker and dev:web with labelled output; Ctrl-C stops all three
Compose containers keep running afterwards; stop them with `docker compose stop`
notes: Stopping sends the server more than one signal (tsx and concurrently both forward), so its shutdown is idempotent: closing the pg pool twice rejects

searchText: local development dev script docker compose concurrently shutdown
subject: dev.local
